name: walk-guard
description: PreToolUse(Bash) guard for the build hosts (redbaron, ryzen7): refuses an unbounded grep -r / rg / find / du / ls -R of /mnt/data, /mnt/ssd or ~ unless it carries ionice -c3 + nice -n19 + timeout <= 600, and prints the rewritten command. Contract: contracts/walk-guard.json.
